Tip: Total Graphics Power (TGP) is also called Continuous Electrical Design Point (EDPc). The peak EDP
(EDPp) of the GPU can be as much as 80% higher than the EDPc. When adjusting the EDPc, the related
EDPp is also adjusted in the same ratio. On top of changing the EDPc, the GPUs support setting a
programmable EDP which is limiting the EDP peak to a minimum of 44% above the set EDPc.
